0.0.n: A standard greeting, generally used during the daytime.

0.2.n: ポル伝 is a shortened name for the show ポルカの伝説.

0.3.n: Borrowed from English; Japanese does not change this word for one person or several.

0.4.n: Links the staff affiliation to the name that follows, identifying Izutsu as a member of that staff.

0.5.n: This is the speaker's family name.

0.6.n: A polite sentence ending used here to introduce oneself; the word for I is omitted.

1.0.n: Read as きょう here; it sets the time for the test.

1.1.n: Marks today as the topic: what follows explains today's plan.

1.2.n: This is the name of the person who will not be told about the test.

1.3.n: Added after Polka's name to address or refer to her politely.

1.4.n: With 内緒, marks the person from whom something is kept secret.

1.5.n: Pairs with で to describe doing something without telling the named person.

1.6.n: Makes 内緒 describe how the test will be carried out.

1.7.n: Placed before a noun to introduce something specific without revealing exactly what it is.

1.8.n: Refers to checking whether an idea or claim holds true.

1.9.n: Marks 検証 as the activity being performed with します.

1.10.n: The polite form of する; here it announces a planned action.

2.0.n: Signals a transition from the introduction to the show.

2.2.n: With the following の, specifies which installment viewers are about to watch.

2.3.n: Links 今日 to the show title, making it today's installment.

2.4.n: This name is part of the show's full title, ポルカの伝説.

2.5.n: Links Polka to 伝説 within the title, like Polka's legend.

2.6.n: This noun completes the show title ポルカの伝説.

2.7.n: Marks today's show as what viewers are invited to enjoy.

2.8.n: Uses お + 楽しみ, the stem of 楽しむ, + ください to make a polite invitation.

0.lit: Hello. Legend of Polka staff member Izutsu am.
0.tip: Japanese often omits I in introductions, so a name followed by です can mean I'm that person.

1.lit: Today, as for, from Polka in secret, a certain test will conduct.
1.tip: ポルカさんに内緒で means without telling Polka; ある belongs with 検証, meaning a certain test.

2.lit: Now then, today's Polka's legend, please enjoy.
2.tip: お楽しみください is a polite invitation commonly used when introducing a show or presentation.
